verdicts.reason: A: strong two-column structure with a big controller and a dominant headline, but the CTA sits top-right above the headline, which breaks reading order, and it is right-aligned while the text column is left-aligned. The FIZZBANG logo and can are pushed down to a bottom-corner row, where the can is undersized. B: the CTA floats roughly centred and doesn't line up with the left edge of the text column. The logo and can are shrunk to near-illegible specks in the lower area, the controller hugs the left edge, and large dead space is left on the right and bottom, so the brand is badly diminished.
